faq_heading: Questions businesses ask about AI calling agents

faqs.q: How much does an AI calling agent cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on call volume, the languages, the call flows and the systems it connects to. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the call flows and the number of connections to your CRM and phone system. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis, based on your actual material.

faqs.q: Which systems can it connect to?
faqs.a: Typically your CRM, calendar and phone system, so bookings and call notes appear where your team already works. The exact list is confirmed during diagnosis.

faqs.q: Can it transfer a call to a person?
faqs.a: Yes. It can transfer to a named team during staffed hours, or book a callback at a time the caller chooses. It always passes on a summary of the conversation.
